Chronic myeloid leukaemia data: static covariates and survival outcome

Source: R/data.R
cml.Rd

Survival outcome and baseline (static) risk factors for 190 patients from the Benelux Chronic Myeloid Leukaemia (CML) trial (Kluin-Nelemans et al. 1998). The data were originally distributed in the archived dynpred package (as wbc1).

Usage

data(cml)

Format

A data frame with 190 rows, one per patient:

id

integer: patient identifier, shared with cml_wbc.

tyears

numeric: time in years until death or last follow-up.

d

survival status; 1 = death, 0 = censored.

sokal

numeric: Sokal score, a clinical risk index based on spleen size, percentage of circulating blasts, platelet count and age at diagnosis.

age

numeric: age at diagnosis (years).

Source

The archived dynpred package (GPL (>= 2)), companion to van Houwelingen & Putter (2012).

References

van Houwelingen HC, Putter H (2012). Dynamic Prediction in Clinical Survival Analysis. Chapman & Hall.

Kluin-Nelemans JC, Delannoy A, Louwagie A, le Cessie S, Hermans J, van der Burgh JF, Hagemeijer AM, van den Berghe H, Benelux CML Study Group (1998). Randomized study on hydroxyurea alone versus hydroxyurea combined with low-dose interferon-alpha 2b for chronic myeloid leukemia. Blood. 1998; 91: 2713-2721.

See also

cml_wbc for the companion longitudinal biomarker data.
